formattedAddress: 108, Taiwan, Taipei City, Wanhua District, Ximen Village, Xining Rd, 70號B1之15室

text.text:
The restaurant is located in the basement of
Wan Nian Commercial Building (萬年商業大樓) in Ximending.

It’s a bit hidden — you have to go down to the basement level. The area feels like an old-school food court, but each stall is clearly separated.

This was one of my favorite meals in Taiwan

Rich, flavorful broth, tender beef, and freshly handmade noodles. The dumplings were amazing too — especially with chili oil.

Very local, cash only, and totally worth finding.

I’m already craving it again just thinking about it.

text.text: A go to spot among locals for a quick, satisfying bowl of beef tendon noodles and dumplings. While they offer a variety of items, this is clearly what they’re known for; and for good reason. The sauce bar is a standout, with sour cabbage, chilli oil, fresh green onions, and soy sauce for dipping; so you can not only customize each bowl to your liking but also mix the perfect dip for your dumplings. That freedom to season everything exactly how you like it really elevates the experience. The hand-pulled noodles and dumplings are some of the most authentic and flavourful I’ve had in Taiwan. Some might find the dumplings a bit salty, but I think it perfectly complements the dumpling skin, making every bite a true flavour explosion. Easily a 5 star experience and a place I wish I could go to every day.

text.text:
Fantastic handmade noodles with excellent texture and depth of flavor. The dishes here are straightforward, but that simplicity highlights the skill behind them. The noodles are clearly the focus, and they are executed with confidence and consistency.

The atmosphere is very local and no-nonsense, and service is efficient. This is the kind of place you come back to for comfort and reliability. Honest food, done very well.

text.text:
老山東牛肉麵is a fantastic spot for anyone who loves authentic flavors. Keep in mind that is a cash only restaurant.

The dishes are full of rich, delicious taste, and there’s a great variety on the menu to suit different preferences.

The staff is very friendly and welcoming.

The atmosphere is casual and comfortable, perfect for a satisfying meal.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting the area and craving tasty homemade noodles! 🍜✨

text.text:
Decided to try out the beef noodles here because a lot of people recommended this place. The place was a little hard to find as it is located at the basement of Wan Nian building. I ordered a bowl of beef noodles with only beef chunks. As soon as my order came, I took a sip of the soup and found that it didn’t have the “wow” factor. I wished it would be more robust and flavourful.
But the beef, which came in a large chunks, was delightfully tender and fall apart easily. The handmade noodles were wide and chewy, absorbing the broth very well. Portion was huge and very filling. Overall, it was a decent bowl of beef noodles, but nothing spectacular.

Service was not the best as the restaurant was very busy. I didn’t know that there is a condiment counter where I can add some preserved vegetables to my noodles because I wasn’t informed about it.
